This is the [[The_Federation_Cruiser#Layout_A|Federation Cruiser]] ship unlocking event. <span style="color:grey">(the ship can also be unlocked by winning the game with the Engi Cruiser)</span>
----


''You arrive at the beacon to find yourself in a huge Rebel shipyard, scaffolding and construction drones filling the sector! The entire system looks devoted to ship construction, the nearby planets and moons ruthlessly mined to harvest resources for a ship of immense size...''

Even in its weakened state, the Rebel ship powers up... get ready, you've got a hell of a fight on your hands!''

==Ship defeated==
''While the second flagship was not yet finished, it doesn't make the battle any less of a victory... and you've crippled the Rebel fleet's strength considerably! While you don't overstay your welcome, you quickly salvage choice bits of metal, drones, and even an unusual object or two from the wreckage and prepare to jump!''
*You receive a <span style="color:limegreen">weapon</span> with high <span style="color:#70b8ff">scrap</span>, {{Transaction|5|add_fuel}} {{Transaction|5|add_missiles}} {{Transaction|5|add_drones}}, and Rebel Fleet is <span style="color:limegreen">delayed</span> for <span style="color:limegreen">2</span> turns.
**''As you are leaving you detect an interesting Federation ship signal. Apparently the Rebels were reverse engineering the advanced weaponry on a prototype Federation cruiser. You don't know how they captured the ship intact but you program its FTL drive to return the ship to the nearest Federation base. You just hope it gets there unharmed.''
*** You unlock the [[The Federation Cruiser|Federation Cruiser]].

==Trivia==
[[File:Screen Shot 2015-01-03 at 8.32.44 PM.png|thumb|200px|An instance of the ship. System levels and crew number vary.]]
This event is called "FLAGSHIP_CONSTRUCTION" in the data files.
* Contrary to the actual [[The Rebel Flagship|Rebel Flagship]], this ship's system levels and crewmembers vary with difficulty and sector number. The ship's layout closely matches that of the Flagship Phase-3 on Hard mode in that the artillery rooms are connected to the rest of the ship (regardless of the current game's difficulty mode), but lacks the [[Mind Control]] system and the [[The_Rebel_Flagship#Power_Surge_2|Power Surge]].
